card.name: Just before all-caps drug names
card.fires_on: The word or letter just before an all-caps or capitalized drug or warning word that starts with A, such as AMIVUDINE, ALUNBRIG, ANNOVERA or ANEMIA. Seen mostly in all-caps boxed warnings.

modes.label: Split capital word start
modes.description: A single capital letter or short piece that begins an all-caps word in a boxed warning.

modes.label: Word before a brand name
modes.description: A normal word right before a brand name starting with A.
modes.example: particularly during the first week of<< initiating>> ALUNBRIG.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens that begin with capital A letters (AD, AG, AS, AM, AB), so it appears to hold back those starts in the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the lead-in to an all-caps drug or warning word that begins with A.
